prompt: Reference images: image 1 shows the chosen HALO CRYSTAL, image 2 shows the chosen OPTION HUNTER, image 3 shows the chosen GLINT MOTE. Draw every referenced subject exactly as designed — same silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials and rendering — gathered into the sheet described below; where the description and a reference disagree on a detail of a design, follow the reference: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art sprite sheet for a retro arcade shoot-'em-up, perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background, crisp 1-pixel near-black navy outlines, saturated limited palette, dithered shading, no scene, no text, no labels, no UI. Every sprite crisp, readable at game scale, consistent lighting from above. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. Row two has exactly six HALO CRYSTAL frames, the ring shown only by where its six satellites sit: no arrows, no motion lines, no circles or trails anywhere. Row three is the GLINT MOTE exactly as image 3 in every frame — the same four-pointed violet star crystal with a white-hot centre and its three small diamond flecks — never an octagon or round gem; the burst frame is a small star-puff of lilac sparks, not a cloud. Every OPTION HUNTER view faces left like image 2.
